# Product Creator: Specification

No errors or warnings; 1 design hint(s) in “Problems”.

*Generated from the Product Creator catalog. Do not edit this file: change the catalog and generate again.*

## Contents

1. Product
2. Features
3. Data
4. Workflows
5. Streams
6. Drafts
7. Problems

## 1. Product

Feature catalog and traceable product documentation (ТЗ) linked to code

### Vision

Product Creator keeps the logic of a product (features, data, workflows) as YAML next to the code, so people and AI agents plan it together, see planning errors before code is written, and get the spec (ТЗ) generated from the same model.

### Goals

- **G1** Planning and design errors are visible to people and agents as soon as they are written: in the editor, through MCP and in CI
- **G2** Specs for people and for agents are generated from one model and never written twice
- **G3** Every feature is traceable to its code, tickets and tests
- **G4** Agents plan and change the catalog safely through MCP

### Actors

| Actor | Description |
| --- | --- |
| Product owner | Plans features, approves specs |
| Developer | Builds features, links code, runs sync |
| AI agent | Reads and changes the catalog through MCP, locally or through the relay |
| CI | Checks the catalog on every push |
| Client | Reads the human spec |

### External systems

| System | Description | Emits | Consumes |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| GlitchTip | Self-hosted error tracker (Sentry protocol) of ecooz, error.y.ecooz.net | `glitchtip.issue.created` | `app.error.reported`, `app.sourcemaps.uploaded` |
| YouTrack | Issue tracker of the project (ecooz.youtrack.cloud) | `youtrack.issue.created` | `glitchtip.issue.created` |
| GitHub | Source code, CI and the releases the app updates from | `github.release.published` | `youtrack.issue.created` |

### Glossary

| Term | Definition |
| --- | --- |
| Feature | A business capability of the product (formerly function); one YAML file with its spec and links to code |
| Business object | A data entity of the product with typed fields |
| Workflow | An ordered sequence of features with compensations |
| Component | A service or library of a project; each has its own catalog folder |
| Catalog | The YAML files of features, business objects and workflows of a component |
| Lifecycle | draft → approved → implemented → deprecated → removed; each status has its own rules |
| Plan | A set of proposed catalog changes, checked as a whole before anything is written |
| Spec (ТЗ) | The document generated from the model: a human view and an agent bundle |

#### Update the app (`app.update.install`)

*implemented* · Component: Desktop app (Electron) · Tickets: [PRODUCTCREATOR-21](https://ecooz.youtrack.cloud/issue/PRODUCTCREATOR-21)

Signed releases update automatically; a check can be started from the menu.

**Actors:** Product owner

**Requirements**

- **R1** Only a packaged build updates itself: not in dev, not in smoke runs, not with PC_DISABLE_AUTO_UPDATE, on Linux only the AppImage

**Acceptance criteria**

- **A1** (covers R1): canAutoUpdate is true only for a packaged build outside smoke runs and without PC_DISABLE_AUTO_UPDATE

**Decisions**

- **D1** macOS installs updates only into a signed app; Windows builds stay unsigned — No Windows code-signing certificate (PRODUCTCREATOR-21)

### catalog

#### Create and edit a feature (`catalog.feature.edit`)

*implemented* · Component: Core package · Tickets: [PRODUCTCREATOR-7](https://ecooz.youtrack.cloud/issue/PRODUCTCREATOR-7), [PRODUCTCREATOR-32](https://ecooz.youtrack.cloud/issue/PRODUCTCREATOR-32)

Creates or changes a feature card with its spec; the save is validated before writing.

**Actors:** AI agent, Product owner

**Requirements**

- **R1** A feature is saved to features/<context>/<entity>.<action>.yml of its component
- **R2** Spec fields (actors, requirements, acceptance, constraints, decisions, open questions) are saved with the card
- **R3** A save that adds a model error is rejected with the issues

**Acceptance criteria**

- **A1** (covers R2): Reading a card and saving it back keeps every field
- **A2** (covers R3): **Given** a feature whose calls name a missing feature; **When** it is saved; **Then** the response is 400 with unknown_feature
- **A3** (covers R1): A saved card is written to features/<context>/<entity>.<action>.yml, also when it was read from functions/

#### Create and edit a stream (`catalog.stream.edit`)

*implemented* · Component: Core package · Tickets: [PRODUCTCREATOR-7](https://ecooz.youtrack.cloud/issue/PRODUCTCREATOR-7), [PRODUCTCREATOR-34](https://ecooz.youtrack.cloud/issue/PRODUCTCREATOR-34)

Creates or changes a stream: a business process with stages, KPIs and workflows per stage.

**Requirements**

- **R1** Streams are saved as YAML in streams/
- **R2** A stage runs existing workflows and waits for events something emits

**Acceptance criteria**

- **A1** (covers R1, R2): Stream schema, unknown workflows and unknown stage events are reported

**Decisions**

- **D1** Streams stay and are validated: schema, stage workflows, stage events — They describe the business process the workflows serve (2026-11-28)

#### Plan and check a stream (`catalog.stream.plan`)

*implemented* · Component: Core package · Tickets: [PRODUCTCREATOR-43](https://ecooz.youtrack.cloud/issue/PRODUCTCREATOR-43)

A stream is a full catalog entry: lifecycle, tickets, translations, stages with ids that name their features, workflows and performers; it is planned and checked like features and workflows.

**Actors:** Product owner, AI agent

**Requirements**

- **R1** A stream has id like a workflow, name, goal, description, lifecycle, owner, tickets, KPIs (K1…) and stages (ST1…) with entry and exit events, features, workflows and performers (actor or system)
- **R2** validate_plan and apply_plan take streams; a save that adds an error is rejected
- **R3** Unknown stage features, workflows and performers, duplicate stream ids, repeated KPI or stage ids are reported
- **R4** A stage using removed, draft or deprecated features or workflows is reported like a workflow step
- **R5** Texts of a stream are translatable and checked for staleness
- **R6** The stream form edits every field, keeps unknown ones, and has language tabs

**Acceptance criteria**

- **A1** (covers R1, R3, R4, R5): Schema, references, lifecycle and translation checks of streams
- **A2** (covers R2): An agent applies a plan with a stream; a stream with an unknown feature is rejected
- **A3** (covers R6): The stream form has no hard-coded texts and its catalogs are complete

**Decisions**

- **D1** The stream schema is rewritten without migration; rules.unique_function_per_stage is removed — No project has streams; the rule was never checked (2026-11-28)

#### Translate the catalog content (`catalog.translation.edit`)

*implemented* · Component: Core package · Tickets: [PRODUCTCREATOR-37](https://ecooz.youtrack.cloud/issue/PRODUCTCREATOR-37)

Texts of features, business objects, workflows and the product context in the other project languages, stored in i18n.<language> of the same file.

**Actors:** Product owner, AI agent

**Requirements**

- **R1** The project lists its languages; the first is primary and holds the normal fields
- **R2** Translatable fields are declared in the schemas (x-translatable); list items are keyed by id
- **R3** A translation remembers the primary text it was made from; a changed primary text marks it stale
- **R4** Stale translations, translations of removed items and unknown languages are reported by the checks

**Acceptance criteria**

- **A1** (covers R1, R2): Languages are saved in product-creator.yml; translatable paths come from the schemas
- **A2** (covers R3, R4): A changed primary text makes the translation stale; removed items and unknown languages are reported
- **A3** (covers R1): An agent sets languages, writes a translation and reads the spec in that language

#### Write the catalog through MCP (`mcp.catalog.write`)

*implemented* · Component: MCP server package · Tickets: [PRODUCTCREATOR-18](https://ecooz.youtrack.cloud/issue/PRODUCTCREATOR-18), [PRODUCTCREATOR-33](https://ecooz.youtrack.cloud/issue/PRODUCTCREATOR-33)

apply_plan, create_catalog_entry, update_catalog_entry, update_project; writes are validated and rejected with issues.

**Actors:** AI agent

**Requirements**

- **R1** A write that adds model errors is rejected with the issues
- **R2** update merges a patch at the top level; null removes a field
- **R3** apply_plan writes a whole plan at once: entries may reference each other, nothing is written if the plan adds errors, a failed write is rolled back
- **R4** A read-only session is told which setting enables writing

**Acceptance criteria**

- **A1** (covers R1): Creating a feature with an unknown object returns unknown_object
- **A2** (covers R3): A plan with cross-references is applied in one call; a broken plan writes nothing
- **A3** (covers R4): Read-only server instructions name Settings → MCP → scope
- **A4** (covers R2): update_catalog_entry merges the patch; null removes the field

**Requirements**

**Acceptance criteria**

#### Serve MCP to local agents (`mcp.server.serve`)

*implemented* · Component: MCP server package · Tickets: [PRODUCTCREATOR-18](https://ecooz.youtrack.cloud/issue/PRODUCTCREATOR-18)

Streamable HTTP MCP server on 127.0.0.1 with a bearer token and read or write scope; off by default.

#### Describe external systems (`project.system.edit`)

*implemented* · Component: Core package · Tickets: [PRODUCTCREATOR-43](https://ecooz.youtrack.cloud/issue/PRODUCTCREATOR-43)

External systems the product works with (error tracker, issue tracker, release host) in the product context, with the events they emit and consume, so streams can pass through them.

**Actors:** Product owner, AI agent

**Requirements**

- **R1** systems in product-creator.yml: id, name, description, emits, consumes; ids unique and different from actor ids
- **R2** Events a system emits count as emitted, events it consumes as consumed, in the event checks
- **R3** Names and descriptions of systems are translatable like actors
- **R4** Systems are edited in the Workspace project form and through MCP get_project / update_project
- **R5** The spec lists the external systems in the product section

**Acceptance criteria**

- **A1** (covers R1): updateProject saves systems and rejects duplicate ids, ids of actors and bad event names
- **A2** (covers R2): A stream stage waiting for an event a system emits is not reported
- **A3** (covers R4): An agent adds a system with update_project and reads it with get_project
- **A4** (covers R3, R5): The human spec lists the systems, translated in ru

**Decisions**

- **D1** External emitters are systems in the product context, apart from actors — Actors are people and roles; a system has events. Found while planning PRODUCTCREATOR-26 (2026-11-28)

### spec

#### Generate the agent spec bundle (`spec.bundle.generate`)

*implemented* · Component: Core package · Tickets: [PRODUCTCREATOR-35](https://ecooz.youtrack.cloud/issue/PRODUCTCREATOR-35)

Manifest and small chunks per feature, component and interface group, with ids, contracts, objects, acceptance with verify and code anchors.

**Actors:** AI agent

**Requirements**

- **R1** Unresolved validation issues are part of the bundle next to the affected feature
- **R2** Fields marked x-audience: human are left out

**Acceptance criteria**

- **A1** (covers R1, R2): The manifest lists entries with their issues; chunks carry agent fields only, with resolved objects
- **A2** (covers R1): An agent reads the manifest and one chunk through MCP get_spec

**Decisions**

- **D1** One bundle per project: every live feature, object and workflow — Answers Q1. Scoped bundles (component, release by tickets) are PRODUCTCREATOR-38 (2026-11-28)
- **D2** Chunk budget 16 KB; a larger chunk is flagged overBudget in the manifest — Answers Q2. An agent loads one chunk per task; the flag shows entries to split (2026-11-28)

#### Render the spec for people (`spec.document.render`)

*implemented* · Component: Desktop app (Electron) · Tickets: [PRODUCTCREATOR-19](https://ecooz.youtrack.cloud/issue/PRODUCTCREATOR-19), [PRODUCTCREATOR-35](https://ecooz.youtrack.cloud/issue/PRODUCTCREATOR-35), [PRODUCTCREATOR-37](https://ecooz.youtrack.cloud/issue/PRODUCTCREATOR-37)

The Doc page renders the human spec (ТЗ) from the model, per project language, and writes it as Markdown. HTML/PDF export belongs to PRODUCTCREATOR-19.

**Actors:** Client, Product owner

**Requirements**

- **R1** A spec with errors says so on top
- **R2** Problems are shown next to the affected feature
- **R3** Fields marked x-audience: agent are left out
- **R4** The spec is shown in every project language; untranslated text is marked with the primary language

**Acceptance criteria**

- **A1** (covers R1, R2, R3): The human view says Not ready on top when the model has errors, shows problems next to the entry and leaves out agent fields
- **A2** (covers R4): A spec is written per project language with untranslated text marked

**Decisions**

- **D1** One human spec per project language; one agent bundle in the primary language — People read their language, agents need one stable source; translations are optional, so missing ones fall back to the primary text (PRODUCTCREATOR-37) (2026-11-28)

**Screens**

![S1 — The generated spec on the Doc page](../screens/spec.document.render/S1.png)

*S1 — The generated spec on the Doc page*

#### Streams in the spec (`spec.stream.render`)

*implemented* · Component: Core package · Tickets: [PRODUCTCREATOR-43](https://ecooz.youtrack.cloud/issue/PRODUCTCREATOR-43)

Both specs show the streams: people read a section per stream with goal, KPIs and stages; agents get one chunk per stream with its stages resolved.

**Actors:** Client, AI agent

**Requirements**

- **R1** The human spec has a Streams section: goal, KPIs and a stage table with events in and out, features, workflows and performers, and the problems of the stream
- **R2** The agent bundle has streams/<id>.json with the stages and the features, workflows and systems they name
- **R3** Removed streams are left out; draft ones are marked

**Acceptance criteria**

- **A1** (covers R1, R3): The human spec renders a stream with its stages in en and ru
- **A2** (covers R2): The manifest lists stream chunks; get_spec returns one

### sync

#### Link code to features (`sync.code.link`)

*implemented* · Component: Core package · Tickets: [PRODUCTCREATOR-4](https://ecooz.youtrack.cloud/issue/PRODUCTCREATOR-4), [PRODUCTCREATOR-30](https://ecooz.youtrack.cloud/issue/PRODUCTCREATOR-30)

Code sync matches exported code functions to existing features: linked / proposed / candidate / stale. Creates a feature only on request.

**Actors:** AI agent, Developer

**Requirements**

- **R1** A matched code function proposes a link that sets source_file and calls
- **R2** An unmatched code function is a candidate; nothing is created by default
- **R3** A feature whose code is gone is stale; it is never marked removed automatically

**Acceptance criteria**

- **A1** (covers R1, R2, R3): Matching yields linked, proposed, candidate and stale items

**Decisions**

- **D1** calls are set when a code function is linked; later runs skip linked features and do not refresh calls — Current behaviour: hand-edited calls are never overwritten; to refresh, unlink and link again

**Business objects:** `feature` (write), `code_link` (write)

#### Import business objects from Prisma (`sync.schema.import`)

*implemented* · Component: Core package · Tickets: [PRODUCTCREATOR-3](https://ecooz.youtrack.cloud/issue/PRODUCTCREATOR-3), [PRODUCTCREATOR-34](https://ecooz.youtrack.cloud/issue/PRODUCTCREATOR-34)

Schema sync creates and updates business objects from a Prisma schema.

**Requirements**

- **R1** Models become business objects with fields and tables
- **R2** Prisma enums become field types that validation accepts

**Acceptance criteria**

- **A1** (covers R1): A Prisma schema is parsed into models and fields
- **A2** (covers R2): Enum fields are parsed as enum<…> types

**Decisions**

- **D1** A Prisma enum becomes an enum<A\|B> field type — Validation accepts it as a scalar; no separate object kind needed (2026-11-28)

**Business objects:** `business_object` (write)

### validation

#### Lint the catalog from a terminal and CI (`validation.catalog.lint`)

*implemented* · Component: Desktop app (Electron) · Tickets: [PRODUCTCREATOR-29](https://ecooz.youtrack.cloud/issue/PRODUCTCREATOR-29), [PRODUCTCREATOR-33](https://ecooz.youtrack.cloud/issue/PRODUCTCREATOR-33)

`product-creator lint` validates the catalogs of a project; exit code 1 on errors. CI runs it on this repo.

**Actors:** CI, Developer

**Requirements**

- **R1** Exit code is 1 when there are errors
- **R2** --json prints the issues for tools
- **R3** CI fails when this repo's catalog has errors

**Acceptance criteria**

- **A1** (covers R3): pnpm catalog:lint is a CI step
- **A2** (covers R1, R2): lint exits with 1 on errors and --json prints the counts and issues

#### Show what a change affects (`validation.change.impact`)

*implemented* · Component: Core package · Tickets: [PRODUCTCREATOR-29](https://ecooz.youtrack.cloud/issue/PRODUCTCREATOR-29)

For a business object or feature: the features that use or call it, their callers, workflows and objects with fields of its type.

**Requirements**

- **R1** Impact of an object lists features by access and the workflows that use them
- **R2** Impact of a feature lists callers two levels up

**Acceptance criteria**

- **A1** (covers R1, R2): impactOf returns features, workflows and objects with the reason (via)

**Business objects:** `feature` (read), `business_object` (read), `workflow` (read)

#### Check the design, strictness by lifecycle (`validation.design.check`)

*implemented* · Component: Core package · Tickets: [PRODUCTCREATOR-34](https://ecooz.youtrack.cloud/issue/PRODUCTCREATOR-34)

Design-level checks: architecture (calls vs dependsOn, cycles), events, object usage and kinds, lifecycle consistency, completeness of agreed features, code links, OpenAPI, actors, streams. Advisory by default.

**Actors:** AI agent, CI, Product owner

**Requirements**

- **R1** A feature calling a feature of a component its component does not depend on is reported
- **R2** An agreed feature without requirements, with a requirement not covered by acceptance, or with open questions is reported
- **R3** An agreed feature or workflow depending on a draft is reported
- **R4** An implemented feature without an existing source_file is reported
- **R5** References to removed entries and new references to deprecated ones are reported
- **R6** A draft never gets more than a warning from a design check
- **R7** In advisory mode (default) a check is reported one level below its intended severity and blocks nothing; strict and per-check overrides are set in product-creator.yml

**Acceptance criteria**

- **A1** (covers R1): Architecture checks find calls outside dependsOn and cycles
- **A2** (covers R2, R4): Completeness and code-link checks report agreed / implemented gaps
- **A3** (covers R3, R5): Lifecycle checks report drafts, deprecated and removed references
- **A4** (covers R6, R7): **Given** the same model; **When** checks run in advisory, strict, with an override and off; **Then** severities follow the mode, an advisory plan is not rejected, a strict one is

**Decisions**

- **D1** Strictness depends on lifecycle — Drafting is never blocked; agreed work must be complete (2026-11-28)
- **D2** Design checks start advisory: one level below the intended severity — Nothing is blocked while the checks are new; strict is opt-in per project (2026-11-28)

#### Find duplicates before creating (`validation.duplicates.find`)

*implemented* · Component: Core package · Tickets: [PRODUCTCREATOR-29](https://ecooz.youtrack.cloud/issue/PRODUCTCREATOR-29)

Finds entries with the same or a similar name or id.

**Actors:** AI agent

**Requirements**

- **R1** Similar names and ids are found across components

**Acceptance criteria**

- **A1** (covers R1): find_duplicates finds the same entity.action and similar names, also in other components

#### Validate the catalog (`validation.model.validate`)

*implemented* · Component: Core package · Tickets: [PRODUCTCREATOR-29](https://ecooz.youtrack.cloud/issue/PRODUCTCREATOR-29), [PRODUCTCREATOR-32](https://ecooz.youtrack.cloud/issue/PRODUCTCREATOR-32)

Checks the whole model: schemas, ids, references, field types, duplicates, spec items. One implementation for the UI, MCP and CLI.

**Actors:** AI agent, CI, Product owner

**Requirements**

- **R1** References of calls, objects, steps and compensations resolve across all loaded projects
- **R2** Every issue names the entry, the field and a message a person understands
- **R3** Streams are validated too *(should)*

**Acceptance criteria**

- **A1** (covers R1, R2): A catalog with unknown references, types and duplicates reports each with code and field
- **A2** (covers R3): A stream is checked against its schema and its stage workflows must exist

**Constraints**

- **C1** *performance* Validating a catalog of 1000 entries takes under 1 s

**Business objects:** `feature` (read), `business_object` (read), `workflow` (read)

#### Check a plan before writing (`validation.plan.check`)

*implemented* · Component: Core package · Tickets: [PRODUCTCREATOR-29](https://ecooz.youtrack.cloud/issue/PRODUCTCREATOR-29)

Applies proposed upserts and deletes to a copy of the model and reports only the errors the plan introduces.

**Actors:** AI agent

**Requirements**

- **R1** Nothing is written
- **R2** Only errors introduced by the plan make ok false; existing problems are reported separately

**Acceptance criteria**

- **A1** (covers R1, R2): **Given** a plan with a workflow step that does not exist; **When** validate_plan runs; **Then** ok is false, introduced has unknown_feature, no file changed

**Decisions**

- **D1** Plan checks apply changes to a copy of the snapshot — One validation for real and planned state; no second implementation (2026-11-20)

#### Reject saves that break the model (`validation.save.guard`)

*implemented* · Component: Core package · Tickets: [PRODUCTCREATOR-29](https://ecooz.youtrack.cloud/issue/PRODUCTCREATOR-29)

Every save (UI, MCP) is checked before and after the change; it is rejected only if it adds an error.

**Requirements**

- **R1** A catalog that already has problems stays editable
- **R2** The rejection lists the introduced issues

**Acceptance criteria**

- **A1** (covers R1, R2): Writes that add errors are rejected, consistent ones accepted, existing problems stay editable

## 4. Workflows

### Agent plans and writes a catalog change (`agent.plan_change`)

*implemented*

Tickets: [PRODUCTCREATOR-29](https://ecooz.youtrack.cloud/issue/PRODUCTCREATOR-29), [PRODUCTCREATOR-33](https://ecooz.youtrack.cloud/issue/PRODUCTCREATOR-33)

An agent finds duplicates, reads the schema, checks the whole plan and applies it in one call.

**Steps**

1. Find duplicates before creating (`validation.duplicates.find`)
2. Read the catalog through MCP (`mcp.catalog.read`)
3. Check plans through MCP (`mcp.plan.check`)
4. Write the catalog through MCP (`mcp.catalog.write`)

### Onboard a repository (`project.onboard`)

*implemented*

Tickets: [PRODUCTCREATOR-8](https://ecooz.youtrack.cloud/issue/PRODUCTCREATOR-8), [PRODUCTCREATOR-30](https://ecooz.youtrack.cloud/issue/PRODUCTCREATOR-30)

A repository is opened, its components imported, code and Prisma linked, and the catalog validated.

**Steps**

1. Open projects (`project.workspace.open`)
2. Import services and libraries on first open (`project.layout.import`)
3. Link code to features (`sync.code.link`)
4. Import business objects from Prisma (`sync.schema.import`)
5. Validate the catalog (`validation.model.validate`)

### Release a spec (`spec.release`)

*implemented*

Tickets: [PRODUCTCREATOR-34](https://ecooz.youtrack.cloud/issue/PRODUCTCREATOR-34), [PRODUCTCREATOR-35](https://ecooz.youtrack.cloud/issue/PRODUCTCREATOR-35)

Design checks pass, then the agent bundle and the human spec are generated.

**Steps**

1. Check the design, strictness by lifecycle (`validation.design.check`)
2. Generate the agent spec bundle (`spec.bundle.generate`)
3. Render the spec for people (`spec.document.render`)

## 5. Streams

### From an error to the fixed release (`app.error_lifecycle`)

*draft* · Component: Desktop app (Electron) · Tickets: [PRODUCTCREATOR-26](https://ecooz.youtrack.cloud/issue/PRODUCTCREATOR-26)

**Goal:** Errors of users are found and fixed without their help

From an unhandled error on a user machine to the release with the fix installed on that machine.

**KPIs**

- **K1** Releases whose stacks are symbolicated (target: 100%)
- **K2** Time from the first event to the installed fix (target: < 1 week)

| Stage | Starts on | Ends on | Features and workflows | Performed by |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| **ST1** Caught and scrubbed | `app.error.raised` | `app.error.reported` | Report app errors to GlitchTip (`app.error.report`) |  |
| **ST2** Grouped with a readable stack | `app.error.reported` | `glitchtip.issue.created` | Upload the source maps of a release (`app.sourcemaps.upload`) | GlitchTip |
| **ST3** Triaged into a ticket | `glitchtip.issue.created` | `youtrack.issue.created` |  | Developer, YouTrack |
| **ST4** Fixed and released | `youtrack.issue.created` | `github.release.published` |  | Developer, CI, GitHub |
| **ST5** Delivered to the user | `github.release.published` | `app.update.installed` | Update the app (`app.update.install`) |  |

## 6. Drafts

*Not agreed yet: these features may still change.*

### app

#### Report app errors to GlitchTip (`app.error.report`)

*draft* · Component: Desktop app (Electron) · Tickets: [PRODUCTCREATOR-26](https://ecooz.youtrack.cloud/issue/PRODUCTCREATOR-26)

Unhandled errors of the desktop app (main process, renderer, MCP server) are sent to the self-hosted GlitchTip (Sentry protocol) of ecooz, with the app version, without project content.

**Actors:** Developer

**Requirements**

- **R1** Unhandled errors and promise rejections of the main process, the renderer and the MCP server are reported
- **R2** An event carries release product-creator@<version> and environment production, or prerelease for a version with a pre-release tag
- **R3** Reporting is on only in builds that have a DSN; the DSN is set by the release workflow, so local and dev builds send nothing
- **R4** No catalog or YAML content, file contents or user paths leave the machine; MCP tokens (pcmcp_), relay keys (rld_, rly_) and Bearer values are removed from events and breadcrumbs
- **R5** Stack traces of a release are readable (source maps of that release)

**Acceptance criteria**

- **A1** (covers R4): The scrubber removes tokens, keys, Bearer values, user paths and request bodies from an event and its breadcrumbs
- **A2** (covers R2, R3): Options: disabled without a DSN; release and environment follow the version
- **A3** (covers R1, R5): A test error of a packaged release build is in GlitchTip with its release, environment and a symbolicated stack

**Constraints**

- **C1** *security* sendDefaultPii is off; no IP, user name or home path in events
- **C2** *performance* No tracing: tracesSampleRate 0; reporting adds no work to the UI thread

**Decisions**

- **D1** Self-hosted GlitchTip error.y.ecooz.net, org ecooz, project product-creator — The pattern of monkey-mobile; Consolieri desktop, named in the ticket, has no error reporting (2026-11-28)
- **D2** Always on in release builds, no opt-out — Decided by the product owner; the user docs say what is sent (2026-11-28)
- **D3** DSN injected at build time from a GitHub Actions secret, never in the repository — Same as the mobile apps (build-time env); a build without it is a no-op (2026-11-28)

**Emits:** `app.error.reported`

#### Upload the source maps of a release (`app.sourcemaps.upload`)

*draft* · Component: Desktop app (Electron) · Tickets: [PRODUCTCREATOR-26](https://ecooz.youtrack.cloud/issue/PRODUCTCREATOR-26)

The release workflow uploads the source maps of the main, preload and renderer bundles to GlitchTip for the release, then removes them from the packaged app.

**Actors:** CI

**Requirements**

- **R1** Source maps of main, preload and renderer are uploaded for release product-creator@<version> before packaging
- **R2** The packaged app contains no .map files
- **R3** Without the upload token the release still builds and says that maps were not uploaded *(should)*

**Acceptance criteria**

- **A1** (covers R2): After the strip step out/ has no .map files
- **A2** (covers R1): The release in GlitchTip has the uploaded maps; a test error is symbolicated
